sources.label: followers, retention and ready jobs region

cards.title: Helper actors
items: connectEngineSession (Connecting, Reconnecting): reads the catalog and active libraries, then restores this tab's saved job IDs; expired jobs are dropped silently and an offline job read rejects the attempt
watchConnectionFailures (Ready): subscribes to the query cache and sends connection.lost when any engine read for this endpoint or its origin fails with a connection failure
followJob (Ready, one per job as job:<id>): reports job.updated, job.settled or job.followFailed; stopped when Ready exits or, once every retained job is active, its saved ID is evicted
refreshLibraries (Refreshing): re-reads active libraries with no cache reuse

cards.title: Transition effects
items: connect aborts the session controller and starts a new attempt; from Connecting or Reconnecting it replaces the pending one; leaving Ready stops followers and the watcher
done stores the engine, catalog, libraries and restored jobs; entering Ready follows queued and running jobs
library job succeeded: job.accepted or job.updated where a library create, delete, move or undo job first reaches succeeded; it restarts a running refresh
Refresh done stores libraries; a non-connection refresh error sets a notice and returns to Ready
connection.lost comes from the watcher or is raised by an offline failure, job.followFailed or refresh error; connect errors show connection_failed

cards.title: Notices, jobs and persistence
items: In Ready, job.accepted saves IDs newest first (128 max) and follows; job.updated records; job.settled unwatches; job.resume re-follows a known job; an expired job is forgotten; other failures become coded notices
error.reported and error.dismissed set or clear the notice in every state
Only monitored job IDs persist, per endpoint, in sessionStorage; useEngine (EngineApp) sends requests only in Connected · ready
disconnect clears catalog, libraries, jobs and notice; connection.lost keeps the last job list; Reconnecting keeps the old catalog visible

cards.title: Bounded job retention
items: Accepting a job keeps the newest 128 saved IDs, dropping the oldest settled job first as Engine CLI does; an active job and its follower leave only when every retained job is active. Eviction never cancels server jobs

Late updates for evicted IDs leave retained jobs unchanged; evicted jobs leave before updateJobs applies its bound; ordering drops jobs absent from saved IDs; retainJobIds, updateJobs and savedJobIds share MAX_JOBS

cards.title: Hook lifetime: reviewed addition
items: Reviewed addition at 287b5ef, separate from the original pinned source evidence; committed source links are in the architecture index. The XState states and server-job ownership are unchanged
useActorLifetime owns a hook cancellation signal: React cleanup aborts pending connect and terminal-job waits; effect reconnection creates a fresh scope, including StrictMode
Disposed callbacks cannot reconnect or submit. Cancelled reads resolve without a result; perform rejects through EngineError. UI disposal does not cancel accepted server jobs

cards.title: Saved-job restoration: reviewed addition
items: Reviewed addition at 51a7706, separate from the original pinned source evidence; committed source links are in the architecture index. The session states and server-job ownership are unchanged
connectEngineSession uses p-map with four concurrent saved-job reads and the connection actor's signal; replacing or stopping the attempt prevents queued reads from starting
Each read uses engineJobQuery and fetchEngineQuery: cancellation releases this attempt's query observer while another owner can retain the shared request
Expired IDs are removed from saved history only after the whole restore attempt completes without cancellation; an aborted attempt cannot persist partial cleanup
EngineClient preserves body-read cancellation instead of converting it into invalid-response or unavailable errors

cards.title: Query ownership: reviewed addition
items: Reviewed addition at 4e1910cd22136aa2a475a64e645972307ba9d790, separate from the original pinned source evidence; committed source links are in the architecture index. The session states, server jobs, and persistent saved-job IDs keep their existing owners.

engineKeys owns the shared query-key families. Catalog requests use the server origin, so different libraries on one server share a catalog; collection tracks, staging, jobs, performance and beat grids retain the full library endpoint. Desktop checks additionally include the connection observation generation.

Typed queryOptions factories bind these keys to EngineClient reads and forward the native query signal. Library opening uses shared mutationOptions and invalidates that server origin’s opened-library query after success.

watchConnectionFailures uses engineKeys.isForEndpoint to observe failures for the current library endpoint or its shared server origin. Cancellation still releases only the caller’s observer through fetchEngineQuery; another observer may keep a shared request alive.

cards.title: Navigation and cancellation: committed 2b1d6e1
items: Independently reviewed addition at 2b1d6e10b5eece1a666b22394bab878394c632bb, separate from the original pinned evidence and the earlier query-ownership addition. Committed source links are in the architecture index; uncommitted identity and test-warning changes are outside this evidence.

useLibraryNavigation uses native useMutation with the same openLibraryMutation options as useLibraryRoute and useLibraryOpening. After opening on the selected server, it reads fresh opened-library and preference listings before deriving the library link and navigating.

useEngine sends cancellation through native useMutation while retaining the session actor and React lifetime signals. A successful response cancels the exact in-flight job query, replaces its cached job, and updates the session only while its signal remains active. Confirmed uncancelled failures still use job_cancel_failed guidance.
This integration adds no session state, actor, endpoint, persistent store, or database owner. Query observers, server jobs, and Engine API protection retain their existing ownership.

cards.title: Discovery commands: committed 2869978
items: Independently reviewed addition at 286997860c1ccb2aa94e5ece182d616b538f4e8e, separate from the original pinned evidence. Committed source links are in the architecture index; later consumer changes are outside this evidence.

library.discover remembers libraries on the server. runLibraryDiscovery submits it through an origin-bound native MutationObserver; the shared mutation cache coalesces pending commands across owners and Refresh. Passive query observers never submit on invalidation, focus, or ordinary rerenders.

Only the route server activates discovery automatically: route/capability activation, browser online reconnect, and a stable ready-session generation check the shared 30-second freshness window. Explicit Refresh can also discover on an inactive server, including after its refreshed catalog first advertises the operation.

Accepted discovery jobs continue across sidebar unmounts and route changes. Mutation callbacks retain the last successful library result and safe failure code in the origin query cache; failures preserve the last-success timestamp, and success clears the failure. Resetting the settled command observer permits native mutation garbage collection without losing this observation.

Discovery command ownership adds no XState state, actor, API endpoint, or persistent store. Collection reads retain their library-endpoint isolation; Engine CLI retains library registration and database ownership.

cards.title: Rating coherence: reviewed addition
items: Separately reviewed at 078d5c5230e2d02c4057dd3286b1a94189aef6dd; the original session graph, source pins and earlier ownership additions remain unchanged. TrackRating uses the same protected track.update collection-edit path for deck and collection controls.

After the write settles, TrackRating projects only the confirmed exact rating field into the existing endpoint/id-scoped detail cache, then awaits the active exact query with cancelRefetch false: https://github.com/alexgorbatchev/engine-ui/blob/078d5c5230e2d02c4057dd3286b1a94189aef6dd/src/components/TrackRating.tsx#L18-L46

A successful write or undo invalidates endpoint track queries through followJob, cancelling older detail reads before their replacements. The rating control joins the current read; a failed detail refetch preserves the confirmed cache value: https://github.com/alexgorbatchev/engine-ui/blob/078d5c5230e2d02c4057dd3286b1a94189aef6dd/src/machines/followJob.ts#L10-L29

Only an in-flight submission overlays stars. Refreshed same-track data and undo stay authoritative in the native Query cache. Clear confirmation and live Desktop protection reuse existing submission/edit actors; staged previews remain read-only. No second accepted-value store or persistence owner is added.
